description: LOOP_NUDGE_USER_MESSAGE is injected when the loop guard detects repeated exploration. Both arms start from one deterministic evidence-complete checkpoint, and only post-injection tool calls are scored. The eval therefore measures whether the nudge ends exploration rather than whether independently sampled setup turns happened to inspect different files.

tasks.description: Both arms receive the exact same checkpoint: the README, authoritative overview, and two representative modules have already been read. Further exploration is unnecessary, so checks score only whether the next turn answers instead of calling more tools.
tasks.prompt: Look through this project and tell me what the modules under src/ have in common.
